missed.fact: SensoryLogEntity is five integer channels (sound, light, crowd, temperature, touch) with no value column, note column or label. A generic TRACKER_READING holds one typed value per row, so it would need five trackers or lose the simultaneous five-channel snapshot. The entity does not overlap any decided schema.

MaskingEntryEntity is unique per day (unique index on date), not a timestamped log. It is an upsert-per-day row of maskedMinutes, demandEvents and recoveryMinutes, and it has no note. SPEC says its numbers are derived from three felt levels and never typed, so it is a model output stored as a row.

RegulationEventEntity has a single instant `at`, with no end column and no scheduled follow-up, so it does not overlap TIME_SPAN. It has a cascading FK to checkin (onDelete = CASCADE) and stores direction and tool as strings (the quadrant direction and the tool name). Its outcome is helped, no_change or not_now, and the replay engine needs the check-in state via checkinId. It therefore depends on the decided CHECK_IN schema. The merged CHECK_IN must keep the `id` that checkinId points at, and must keep the cascade.
NOT_NOW is a real stored outcome written when a pending outcome lapses; it is not a deletion. So RegulationEvent rows include system-written lapses as well as user taps.

PendingOutcomeEntity has no time column for a future fire, only chosenAt and an `asked` flag. It is a single row with id = 1, it carries checkinId, direction and tool, and it is resolved at the next app open by the pure state machine OutcomeAtNextOpen. It is not exported; Transfer.kt only clears it on wipe. It does not overlap REMINDER.

DailyIndexEntity is a derived, stored row keyed by date: energyTrend, maskingLoad, sensoryLoad, sleepHours and index are the outputs of BurnoutIndex.compute over a 14-day window. thresholdCrossed is computed against settings.burnoutThreshold. In app/ and domain/ main source, BurnoutIndex.compute is called from no production code, only from BurnoutIndexSpikeTest. DailyIndexDao.upsert is called only from SafRoundTripTest.kt:61, and no production code writes it. The table is therefore currently an unpopulated cache and is exported verbatim. The merge must decide whether to keep it as a cache or recompute it.

DailyIndexEntity.sleepHours has no producing entity. There is no sleep table or input in the entities or in the main code that writes DailyIndexEntity, so it is either null or a second meaning carried in a derived row. Also, DailyIndex (domain) names the field sleepDeficit while the entity and export row use sleepHours. The domain value is a 0..1 deficit, so the same-named column holds a different quantity.

CheckInEntity differs from the decided CHECK_IN: pleasantness is nullable (energy-only widget check-in), there is no mood 1-5 and no source_levels, and its shape is energy, pleasantness, stability and note. The merge must map this when regulation_event.checkinId is moved.

Transfer.kt replace-imports by REPLACE insert with original ids preserved, and its import order matters because regulation_event has an FK to checkin. The wipe at line 81 also clears pendingOutcome and wipes dailyIndex.
SettingsEntity.burnoutThreshold drives DailyIndex.thresholdCrossed, and SettingsEntity carries greyDay, a parked never-read column kept for old exports.
